parameters.formDescription: Upload a resume and paste the job description. Returns a deterministic score, the checks that failed, and the job-description terms the resume never mentions.

nodes.name: Score Resume
nodes.notes: Calls the ResumeRadar FastAPI service. The scoring logic lives in the Python package, not in this workflow, so the CLI and the workflow can never drift apart. Set this URL to wherever the service runs: localhost:8000 for self-hosted n8n, or a public tunnel URL for n8n Cloud, which cannot reach your machine.

nodes.name: Rewrite Flagged Bullets
nodes.notes: The API key comes from an n8n credential. Never paste it into this node.

nodes.name: Append To Sheet
nodes.notes: Pick your spreadsheet and tab after import. Header row: timestamp, company, role, resume, score, max_score, percent, keyword_percent, failed_checks, missing_keywords, rewrites.
